items.headline: $GNO: Rotki Founder Says Gnosis Pay Leaked His Wallet Data
items.summary: Rotki's founder shared a notice saying $GNO's Gnosis Pay consumer-card system was breached on Nov. 3, exposing address, card and wallet details. Funds were reportedly unaffected.

items.headline: $T: Threshold Sets tBTC Restart After Week-Long Pause
items.summary: Threshold ($T) set a target to reconnect tBTC as redemptions stay paused pending operator return. Aave's $123.2M Ethereum Core tBTC reserve remains frozen.

items.headline: $STRK Slumps 57% in Four Weeks as Starknet Rally Unwinds
items.summary: $STRK extended its reversal as Starknet DeFi TVL fell to $35.8M after Extended moved settlement to Arc. The proposed Layer 1 transition is still only at research stage.

items.headline: $ALGO: Algorand Foundation Shuts Forum and Advisory Council
items.summary: The Algorand Foundation is closing its forum and advisory council, pausing xGov grants on Dec. 6 and shelving Project King Safety. Bonus staking support runs through January 2028.

items.headline: $AAVE: Aave Labs Buys Avon Team in Fixed-Rate Push
items.summary: Aave Labs acquired Avon's team, lending protocols and onchain order book to build fixed-rate lending for $AAVE. No first market or launch date has been named.
